whatThisFileIs: An R1 authorship claim for the AFC-313 change: add services/directus/schema/bootstrap/** to REVIEW_REQUIRED_PATHS in scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh, extend the guard's --self-test to cover the new path in both directions, and document why bootstrap is on R2 and what is exempt (nothing). The CTO (MediaTech) is the author of both paths. bootstrap/ is the only place on the deploy path that creates a role (ADR-0002); before AFC-313 a comment in the engine needed a second reader and a privilege-boundary edit in bootstrap did not (finding F6 of the CTO verdict on AFC-244). The commit still requires a second reviewer under docs/planning/repo-plan.md line 68 ('Critical paths (auth, permissions, data migrations) require a second reviewer (CTO or SecurityEngineer)') and under the issue's own charter: the author is the CTO, so the reviewer is SecurityEngineer, requested as a child issue of AFC-313 before this commit lands. A reviews[] entry naming that review issue and verdict will be added to this file at commit time.
basis: AFC-313 closes finding F6 of the CTO review of the AFC-244 credential policy. REVIEW_REQUIRED_PATHS (R2) covered engine/**, migrations/**, tests/db/** and two scripts, but not services/directus/schema/bootstrap/ -- the only path in the repository that creates a role on the deploy path. The erase-capable credential in docs/security/credential-inventory.md (retention_job, the only identity that can erase a person's data) is created by 0001_roles.sql; DIRECTUS_KEY/DIRECTUS_SECRET are provisioned via the Actions environment, not from bootstrap. The change adds exactly one pattern, services/directus/schema/bootstrap/**, and nothing else. The matcher already translates '**' to a prefix that crosses '/', so no code change to glob_match/review_required was needed. NOT-ALLOWLISTED, ON PURPOSE: nothing under bootstrap/ is exempt, README.md included, and no blanket 'bootstrap/<x> is fine' line was added -- if a construct ever needs an exemption it is an R2 edit naming the construct, following 9f55a05 (AFC-233). Argument parsing is untouched, so the AFC-256 caller-arity handling (CHECK_COMMIT_MAX_ARGS, the dispatcher arity branch and audit_callers) is unchanged; the gate was not made advisory. Two new --self-test assertions cover the path: 9e asserts review_required matches bootstrap/0001_roles.sql and does NOT match the sibling prefix bootstrap-notes/x.sql, and a new block 9o drives check_commit over a real bootstrap commit in both directions.
verificationRecorded: SELF-TEST, before and after: bash scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh --self-test exits 0 both times; 45 'self-test ok' lines before, 47 after, the +2 being 9o's 'an unreviewed bootstrap commit is refused by R2 and names the path' and 'the same bootstrap commit passes once a reviewer is named'. BOTH-DIRECTIONS CONTROL, run against the repository's own history in a throwaway repo: one commit that edits services/directus/schema/bootstrap/0001_roles.sql, carries an Issue: AFC-313 trailer and a claim with an author, but names NO reviewer. The pre-change guard (git show HEAD:scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh) exits 0 on it -- bootstrap is not on R2 at HEAD. The post-change guard (working tree) exits 1 and prints 'touches the R2 compliance path: services/directus/schema/bootstrap/0001_roles.sql' followed by the R2 VIOLATION that names the missing reviewer. Same commit, two guards, opposite verdicts. pnpm test, before and after: exits 1 at exactly gate:adr-uniqueness and nothing earlier, identically in both runs -- a pre-existing duplicate (two tracked docs/adr/ADR-0006-*.md files, AFC-271 territory) that this change does not touch and does not fix. All gates before it (gate:self-test, gate:awareness, gate:retention, gate:migration-privilege, gate:rollback-control) pass identically before and after. pnpm test:db: 16 suites passed, 0 failed, 566 assertions, 0 failing, identical before and after (this change touches no SQL).

reviews.findings: F1 (non-blocking, low): the R2 comment overstated the credential claim -- fixed on AFC-313 by narrowing to the erase-capable deploy-path credential. F2 (observation): scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh itself is not in REVIEW_REQUIRED_PATHS -- filed as AFC-339, not blocking.
